inquiry: We're keen to drive the Babusar Pass and then carry on to Fairy Meadows. Three of us, 9 days, starting mid-June. British passports. Around 1000 dollars each.

brief.notes: Babusar opens 07-01; mid-June is too early

notes: A near miss rather than an obvious one: Fairy Meadows is open in mid-June but Babusar Pass does not open until July. Tests whether a partially-closed request is caught, or waved through because most of it works.
